_doc: Policy for dynamic hunt-network (game/fleet/hunt_net.py). Four priority lanes: (1) on-demand Escort/Protection (0 ships held when space is clear), (2) Coordinated Group Packs (3/5/8/10 ships targeting 25% of Military for tough wildlife & lone NPC pirates), (3) Power-Ratio Gated Solo Herd Hunting (auto-scales T0->T5+, F38 keep_herd=2, instant cooldown rotation), (4) Low-burn XP fallback.
